name: Kirisaki Ruri
source: Kazuhiko's underclassmate. They often meet before school, after school, or while between classes in the hall. She seems to have a crush on Kazuhiko but she's extremely shy. She's very naive but not stupid, she knows what sex is and how babies are made but she's very trusting that Kazuhiko will not make her pregnant.
